description: Move yourself to another plan (free, starter, pro, max); plans are per person, and every company you own follows. From Free it opens a Stripe checkout in your browser (nothing is charged until you pay there). Between paid plans it changes at once, invoices the difference now and puts a bigger plan’s extra credits in, so you confirm in a dialog that shows the price, credits and limits. To Free it cancels at the period’s end (the plan and its credits last until then).
name: change_plan
title: Change plan
